premises.text: Small businesses need affordable branding solutions
premises.evidence_span: Over 80 million small businesses out there want branding, need branding, but can't really afford it.

premises.text: Current branding options are either too expensive or low quality
premises.evidence_span: you're faced with two options. Either pay hundreds and thousands of dollars for online crowd-sourced services, or if you're like most businesses who can't afford that, you end up doing something on your own and compromise for really low-quality branding.

premises.text: Taylor can design a brand using a learning system based on design rules
premises.evidence_span: Taylor is a learning system that turns your computer into a graphic designer. Using thousands of design rules from the simplest color circle to how fonts interact and what industry is using what style, Taylor is able to study your business and then design the perfect brand for it.

premises.text: Taylor can generate a large number of unique design options
premises.evidence_span: for every one user input we currently estimate, Taylor can generate 350,000 different design options.

premises.text: The design process is transparent and payment is only made after satisfaction
premises.evidence_span: the whole process is completely transparent, and no money exchanges hands until you're completely thrilled with your new design.

premises.text: Taylor provides ongoing design services for various business needs
premises.evidence_span: it's going to walk with your company and design everything it can possibly need.

premises.text: Great branding is crucial for business success
premises.evidence_span: we believe great brands are crucial for a business success.

premises.text: The market for small business branding is large and Taylor is well positioned to capture it
premises.evidence_span: The 80 million small businesses account for a $10 billion industry. And Taylor is well positioned to take over this industry.

value.text: Small businesses can access high-quality branding at an affordable price
value.evidence_span: we want to make that accessible.

notes: Promo codes and demo details excluded as traction.
